Name: Gaming Room Custom Furniture
Author: Robokit12
Description:
OUTDATED MOD! Please note! I don´t plan on modding anymore. But if someone feels like it don't hesitate to change/update and reupload any of my files. I wouldn´t mind it.

[b]Includes:[/b]

GamingStation (animated decor)
Gaming Mat(Rug)
Pouf(useable as chair)
Computer Desk(decor)
Bookshelf (decor)

All items can be bought at Robins Carpenter Shop.

A DGA version converted by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/124850573]NOAV7[/url] can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16550]here[/url].

 
[b]Installation:[/b] Just download the file and extract it to your mod folder.

Please note that items may conflict with other installed custom furniture if those were created with Platonymous Custom Furniture Mod! If this happens just open the GamingRoom.json file and change the "id" number to something else that isn´t used yet (e.g. 6 to 26).

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254]Custom Furniture Mod by Platonymous

If anyone is more familiar with modding and feels like making my stuff more functional - please, feel free to change the file according your ideas. Do as you like, reupload my stuff (NexusMods only) - just don´t forget about the credits ;).

Hope you enjoy :)!
